prerequisites: fetch and compare origin/main before P12
reuse the frozen Node Profile and Node Events contracts
preserve Telemetry Export as output-only and Runtime-owned delivery authority
authorityBoundary: Control owns telemetry_link revisions plus proxy Operation/Audit. Runtime PostgreSQL owns Active/LKG, collector cursor, outbox, retry, ACK and status. Redis is wake-only. P12 may expose organization-facing profile/events but cannot add telemetry query, evaluation, reconciliation or a second event stream.
